messages:
tereza (People Ops): Quick note re: calibration headroom and a small batch of waiver requests we approved. Short thread because I know everyone's swamped.

ben (HRBP): What's 'calibration headroom' in this context? new term to me.

tereza (People Ops): Good callout. Headroom = the number of discretionary adjustments (up/down) chairs can apply during calibration without needing exec review. We temporarily increased it by +2 for two small teams that had heavy OOO weeks.

omar (Eng Director): Which teams got the extra headroom and why? want to ensure fairness across org.

tereza (People Ops): Teams: infra-tools and sdk-platform. Reason: multiple managers were out during review window and several high-performing contributors had late-manager sign-offs that would have forced conservative ratings otherwise. We documented rationale in the tracker.

eli (Eng Manager): I had one late manager sign-off for an IC on SDK. Did that affect their bucket?

tereza (People Ops): We pulled your row into the waiver batch. Approved a single upward adjustment as a waiver (documented: late approval + strong cross-team feedback). You should see a tag 'waiver-approved' in the master tracker.

review-bot: Waiver processed: 1 row appended to waiver_log.csv (auto)

ben (HRBP): Process question: do chairs need to call out that an adjustment used headroom in calibration notes?

tereza (People Ops): Yes please. Chairs should add a single-line justification in the calibration packet: "used headroom: +1 due to late manager sign-off (evidence attached)". That keeps audit trail tidy.

zoe (People Ops): Ops checklist we ran (for transparency):
1) validate manager approval timestamps
2) confirm supporting evidence (peer feedback / notes)
3) check offer/headcount impact with recruiting
4) log waiver in waiver_log.csv

eli (Eng Manager): On the evidence piece: what counts as acceptable supporting evidence for a late upward adj? we had a short Slack thread praising the IC but no formal peer review.

tereza (People Ops): Acceptable = any 2 of the following: documented peer feedback (channel or doc), manager rationale in tracker, product/PM endorsement, or prior performance signals. Slack kudos alone = weak but OK if paired with manager rationale + PM note.

omar (Eng Director): If we use headroom now, will that reduce allowed headroom for next cycle?

tereza (People Ops): No permanent reduction. This was a one-off exception for this cycle only. We'll track usage and surface a short summary to leadership after calibration. If patterns emerge we'll revisit policy.

ben (HRBP): Escalation flow if someone disputes a waiver?

tereza (People Ops): Disputes -> submit a request to people-ops@ with row id; we'll open an audit review. If still unresolved, escalate to HRBP + Director. We log all outcomes.

review-bot: Calibration packet generated: infra-tools (provisional) — 1 waiver flagged. (auto)

zoe (People Ops): Final operational note: if managers still have late sign-offs, please add 'late-evidence' in the tracker and ping me. We'll batch any remaining waiver candidates tomorrow AM and post a final count. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
